subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Reads phonics words in sentences and other texts

show.line: Let's read whole sentences! The goat sat on the boat. Read each word, then read it all together.

accept: the snail is on the leaf
a snail is on the leaf
the snail is on a leaf

rounds.prompt: Read the sentence. The fish is in the net. Which picture matches?
rounds.praise: Yes! The fish is in the net.

rounds.prompt: Read the sentence. Which word is missing? The, gap, is on the road.
rounds.praise: Goat! The goat is on the road.

rounds.story: Mike has a kite. The kite is red. He flies it in the rain. What does Mike have?
rounds.praise: Yes! Mike has a red kite.

hints: Read one word at a time. Then read them all together.
If a word is hard, say its sounds and push them together.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this sentence. The goat sat on the boat.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The got sat on the bot!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Those words have two letters in the middle. Goat, boat.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. The goat sat on the boat!

parent_line: Can read short sentences made of words with the sounds learnt this term.
